Class MachineLibrary

java.lang.Object
assembly.MachineLibrary
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class MachineLibrary extends Object implements Serializable
Repository of reusable state machines keyed by id and name.

    • syncMachineName

      public String syncMachineName(StateMachine machine)
      Synchronize the nameToKey mapping for a machine instance. Call this after external code changes a machine's name directly. Returns the key if found, null otherwise.
      Parameters:
      machine - machine instance
      Returns:
      key for the machine, or null if not found
